THE CITY OF CHEYENNE, COMMENCING JANUARY1,2009."
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE,
WYOMING:
Section_1.That Ordinance No.3515 is repealed effective January 1,2009.
Section 2. Compensation.
A.
The Mayor of the City of Cheyenne shall receive compensation in the amount of
Ninety-Five Thousand Dollars ($95,000.00) per year commencing January 1, 2009.
B.
This Ordinance shall be repealed if the City of Cheyenne changes its form of
government to the citymanager or commission form of government.
Section 3. This ordinance shall be in full force and effect upon publication, and the
compensation here in shall be reviewed approximately every four years from the effective date here of.
